visualCharacteristics.purpose: S Corp self-employment tax savings calculator with result panel and CTA panel

contentPattern.structure: Rows keyed in the first cell: Intro | heading + description; Field | label | help text (optional) | key (optional: net-income, salary, w2-income, w2-ss-withheld, other-se-income; defaults by order); Button | Calculate; Result | result heading | disclaimer; CTA | heading, text, link; Wage base | 184500 (optional, default 184500). Unkeyed rows fall back to intro, field, then CTA

reuseGuidance: Reuse for the same content pattern; background colour comes from section metadata Style (forest, green, bright-green, eggshell, neon, white, black).
